name: Trans-Century Limited
source: TransCentury PLC summary consolidated financial statements, full year results to 31 December 2023 and to 31 December 2022, published through the Nairobi Securities Exchange
source_note: The FY2022 column was printed in both the FY2022 and the FY2023 announcement and the two agree to the unit, which is the cross-check applied here. Total liabilities is the sum of the printed non-current and current liabilities. Total equity is the sum of the printed capital and reserves components plus non-controlling interest. Both sums reproduce the printed total equity and liabilities, so assets equal liabilities plus equity for all three years. The FY2023 audited report states that total liabilities exceeded total assets by KShs 15,102 million, which is the same figure as the derived total equity.

rows.label: Total liabilities
rows.derivedFrom: Total liabilities = Non-current Liabilities + Current Liabilities

rows.label: Total equity
rows.derivedFrom: Total equity = share capital + share premium + revenue reserves + translation reserve + fair value reserve + revaluation reserve + non-controlling interest
